description: This file defines configuration utilities and error handling for setting up camera sessions using AVFoundation. It includes enumerations for errors and methods to add camera inputs, photo output, and movie output to an AVCaptureSession, with support for microphone inclusion and duration settings.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfigurationError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible error conditions encountered during camera session setup, conforming to LocalizedError with descriptive messages.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfiguration
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods to configure an AVCaptureSession by adding inputs and outputs, with error handling.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the session; throws error if adding fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Creates and adds a photo output to the session; throws error if adding fails.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Creates and adds a movie file output, optionally including an audio input, setting maximum duration.
